title: Layer 2 Smell Rule (multi-artifact, source-grounded, deterministic-first)
description: Self-contained smell-detection rule. One per smell per language, under a type's catalog or the cross-cutting general catalog. A rule that fails this schema (e.g., unresolved definition_source_id, missing examples) is rejected at load time (FR-024); a 'judgment' rule or a standard-only rule lacking method evidence is loaded but deferred (FR-039/FR-040).

id.description: Smell id; MUST appear in this rule's catalog (FR-008).

artifact_type.description: Owning catalog. 'general' = cross-cutting Femmer catalog applied to every type (FR-041).

definition_source_id.description: Resolvable {folder}/{first-author}-{year}; MUST resolve via sources.yaml to a retained references/ file with role 'definition' (FR-024/FR-042).

method_source_id.description: Paper-tier method evidence (role 'method'). REQUIRED when the definition source is standard/notation tier and the rule is deterministic & intended to ship (FR-040); else the rule is deferred.

implementable.description: 'deterministic' rules ship and run; 'judgment' rules are loaded, shape-checked, and DEFERRED — never executed (FR-039).

detection_basis.description: Required when language = ja: documents/cites the Japanese realization (FR-020), e.g. japanese/seki-2019.

type.description: Deterministic primitive the engine provides. Adding a rule that uses an existing type needs no engine change (FR-022).

detector.description: Required for shippable (deterministic) rules; may be omitted by judgment (deferred) rules.

positive.description: Artifacts this rule MUST flag (its tests).

negative.description: Artifacts this rule MUST NOT flag (its tests).
